name: Seoul Lantern Festival
description: Every autumn the Cheonggyecheon stream fills with hundreds of illuminated lanterns, from folk-tale figures to giant koi. Walk the 1.2 km route after sunset for the full effect, then grab hotteok from the Gwangjang Market stalls a few minutes away.

name: Icheon Ceramics Hands-on Workshop
description: Icheon has been a pottery town for six centuries. Drop-in studios near the Ceramics Village let you throw a bowl on the wheel or hand-paint a celadon cup; finished pieces are fired and shipped to your hotel about a week later.

name: Busan Night Market Food Tour
description: A guided three-hour walk through BIFF Square and Bupyeong Kkangtong Market, tasting ssiat hotteok, eomuk skewers, and fresh-off-the-boat hoe. Small groups, English-speaking guide, and enough food that dinner afterwards is optional.
